key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0B7A
name: latch_object_if_within_range
description: Compares the sum of two absolute offsets against a threshold scaled from the object's field at index 4 and a global divisor. When inside the threshold it copies three words from the object into globals, sets a countdown global to 8, clears the object's first word and returns -1; otherwise it returns 0.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC0
name: call_object_handler_pointer
description: Loads the code pointer stored at offset 16 of the object record and calls it, with no other work in this routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0BC6
name: advance_object_and_check_hit
description: Updates an object's position and velocity each frame from table-driven scaling, then applies a per-axis correction and calls unnamed routines for the object's state. When a proximity test passes it saves the object's hit values into globals, sets a countdown of 8, appends an entry to a list of events and returns 8; the routine references the text "HIT BY".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D72
name: step_object_motion_with_decay
description: Advances one object by decaying its timer field, ramping a speed value toward its limit, and updating position and velocity from lookup tables. If its alive-check fails or its vertical position is negative, it saves the position into globals, sets a countdown of minus three and clears the object's active word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0D8A
name: step_object_motion_no_decay
description: Advances one object by ramping its speed value toward a limit and updating position and velocity from lookup tables, without touching a timer. If its alive-check fails or its vertical position is negative, it saves the position into globals, sets a countdown of minus three and clears the object's active word.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0EC2
name: check_proximity_window_when_gated
description: If a gate global is zero and the object's field at offset 10 is within 8192 units of a reference global, it sets the object's state word to 3 and returns -1. If the horizontal offset is also within 4096 units, it sets a trigger global to minus one; otherwise it returns 0.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F04
name: check_proximity_window_gate_b
description: Checks a second gate global and, when it is zero, sets the object's state word to 13 and returns -1 when the offset at field 10 lies outside a window of 8192 units around a reference global. When the horizontal offset is within 4096 units it sets a trigger global to minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0F5A
name: check_distance_band_ungated
description: Sets the object's state word to 4 and returns -1 when the offset at field 10 lies outside a band around a reference global, with the band width derived from a global value. When the horizontal offset is within 4096 units it sets a trigger global to minus one.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:0FA8
name: activate_object_and_register_handler
description: If bit 5 of the object's flag byte is clear, it sets that bit, stores a handler pointer into the object, copies three position words into globals, sets a global to 128 and clears a status flag. It then sets a global to minus one when the matching slot is held, and returns 0; if the bit was already set it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:103E
name: register_object_into_slot
description: Returns -1 if the object's bit 7 flag is already set. Otherwise it sets that bit, zeroes the object's counter and stores the object in one of two slot globals, updating the slot state. When the object was the current slot holder, it clears the slot pointer and calls unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1168
name: add_counter_and_arm_timer
description: When a flag global is zero, it adds the level global plus one to an accumulator global and calls an unnamed routine, then sets a timer global to 14. It does nothing when the flag is set.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:118E
name: test_position_window_and_threshold
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then returns 0 when the scaled count field of the object is at least the argument and the absolute offset of field 10 from a reference global, shifted by a threshold, is less than a computed limit. Otherwise it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11AC
name: test_position_window_only
description: Returns 0 when the absolute offset of the object's field 10 from a reference global, minus 16384, lies below a threshold derived from a global level value; otherwise it returns -1. It does not check any count field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11D6
name: test_distance_beyond_limit_guarded
description: Calls an unnamed routine and, when the scaled count field of the object reaches the argument, returns 0 if the absolute offset of field 10 from a reference global is more than 8192 units. Otherwise it returns -1.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:11F4
name: test_distance_beyond_limit
description: Returns 0 when the absolute offset of the object's field 10 from a reference global is more than 8192 units, and -1 when it is within that distance.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:120A
name: update_active_record_timers
description: Walks a table of fixed-size records and, for each active one, decrements its countdown timer. When a timer reaches zero it reloads it by dividing a scaled global by a value derived from the record's fields, and sets a flag bit when the timer equals four while a global is negative.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1280
name: fire_object_into_free_slot
description: When the trigger unnamed routine returns a nonzero value, it stores the object's fields into globals and selects a reload value from a threshold. It then either clears or sets a flag bit and adjusts a velocity field, and when gate and position checks pass it copies the object into the first free table entry and increments a counter; the routine references the text " FIRING ".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:146A
name: scale_active_object_value
description: Returns 0 when the object's state word is zero or minus one. Otherwise it calls an unnamed routine and returns a product of a scaled velocity field and a scaled level global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14B6
name: run_handlers_for_all_records
description: Copies the previous-frame value of a global, clears it, then calls the handler pointer stored in each record of a fixed-size table, in order, for a count taken from a global.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:14E8
name: select_nearest_flagged_record
description: When a counter is below its limit and a distance global exceeds a threshold, it scans a table of records whose flag bits match a fixed pattern. It evaluates each matching record with an unnamed routine and keeps the record with the smallest value, then stores it in a global and calls two unnamed routines.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1576
name: update_tracking_object_motion
description: Integrates an object's velocity and position each frame from table-driven sine scaling, damps its turn and speed fields toward targets, and wraps coordinates that leave range. When a countdown reaches zero it switches to a different handler and stores the first table record whose flags match as its target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:15DE
name: initialize_or_update_tracking_motion
description: Sets the object's flag and handler and zeroes its motion fields when a distance check passes, then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling. It also raises the object's turn and speed fields toward their limits and retargets to the first matching table record when its countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1678
name: update_decaying_object_motion
description: Reduces a secondary counter field by a scaled step, clamping it at zero, and when that counter is already zero it clears flag bits and sets the handler. It then integrates velocity and position from table lookups and retargets to the first matching table record when the lifetime countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:169A
name: update_expiring_object_motion
description: Clears flag bits and sets the handler when the object's counter reaches its limit, then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling. When the lifetime countdown expires it stores the first matching table record as the target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16B6
name: advance_flagged_object_motion
description: Sets the object's flag bits and handler on every call, then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling. When the lifetime countdown expires it stores the first matching table record as the target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16D0
name: advance_launch_phase_motion
description: Adjusts a magnitude field and a counter field depending on the object's state, then restores or ramps a second counter toward its limit and zeroes a velocity field. It then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling and retargets to the first matching table record when the lifetime countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:16DE
name: advance_ramping_object_motion
description: Adds a fixed step to a magnitude field when another field is below 300, then ramps a counter toward its limit or restores the saved handler. It then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling and retargets to the first matching table record when the lifetime countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1708
name: restore_handler_and_integrate_motion
description: Clears a flag bit and restores the handler saved in the object, then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling. When the lifetime countdown expires it stores the first matching table record as the target.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1718
name: compute_aim_and_fire_shot
description: Tests whether the object is near a reference position and computes a steering value from the object's type word and a shared timer bit, clamping it when the vertical speed is large. When a further proximity and flag test passes, it writes a shot entry into a table and marks the object as having fired.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1904
name: integrate_motion_with_type_angle
description: Chooses a target turn value from the object's type word, using a timer-dependent sign for one type and a clamp that zeroes the target and speed when vertical speed exceeds a limit. It then steps velocity toward that target, integrates position from table-driven sine and cosine scaling, and wraps coordinates that leave range.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1940
name: integrate_motion_toward_parameter_angle
description: Sets the target turn value from a parameter word scaled into angle units, zeroing it and the speed when vertical speed exceeds a limit. It then steps velocity toward that target, integrates position from table-driven sine and cosine scaling, wraps coordinates that leave range, and writes a shot-candidate entry into a table when a proximity test passes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1960
name: update_motion_with_gated_retarget
description: When the object's flag bit 8 is clear and a periodic frame test passes, it either resets the object if it is far from the reference, or searches a short table of records for a candidate. It then decrements the lifetime countdown, integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling, and stores the first matching record as its target when the countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:197C
name: update_motion_with_periodic_retarget
description: On a periodic frame test it either resets the object when it lies far from the reference, or searches a short table of records for a candidate. It then integrates velocity and position from table-driven scaling and stores the first matching table record as its target when the lifetime countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A14
name: find_close_candidate_and_update
description: Loops over up to eight table entries and stops at the first whose horizontal distance and vertical separation fall inside given bounds. It then applies the usual speed, position and countdown update and stores the first matching table record as the target when the countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A1E
name: reset_object_to_idle_state
description: Points the object's handler at the idle routine, clears most of its flag bits except the lowest bits and the top three bits, and zeroes a secondary counter field.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A32
name: compute_offset_from_record_field
description: Subtracts the object's field at offset 4 from a precomputed position value and returns the difference shifted right by five bits, after calling three unnamed routines that set up the operands.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A6A
name: return_without_action
description: A stub that only returns, with no instructions beyond the return.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A7A
name: integrate_motion_and_spawn_entry
description: Steps velocity from a lateral input value and integrates position from table-driven scaling, wrapping coordinates that leave range. When a proximity test and a flag test pass, it writes a new entry into a table copying position words from the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A88
name: integrate_motion_with_lateral_input
description: Steps velocity from a lateral input value, integrates position from table-driven scaling and wraps out-of-range coordinates. When a proximity test passes it writes a new entry into a table holding position words copied from the object, then sets the first matching record as target when the countdown expires.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1A98
name: clamp_input_and_integrate_motion
description: Clamps a lateral input value to a negative limit, then steps velocity and integrates position from table-driven scaling, wrapping out-of-range coordinates. When a proximity test passes it writes a new entry into a table with position words copied from the object.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AB0
name: clamp_integrate_and_spawn_entry
description: Clamps a lateral input value, updates the object's position and velocity from table-driven scaling, and wraps out-of-range coordinates. When a proximity test passes it writes a new table entry holding copied position words and a time-to-live value adjusted by a fixed offset.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1AF0
name: spawn_shot_and_integrate_motion
description: Clamps a lateral input, integrates the object's motion from table-driven scaling and wraps out-of-range coordinates, then writes a new shot record into a table on the firing path. The record stores the shooter reference, a scaled velocity value, and a time-to-live adjusted by a fixed offset; the routine references the text " fired by ".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1E7E
name: update_shot_and_record_entry
description: Resets the handler when a counter is not positive and copies the object's handler words into globals, recording the object in a table on a frame-phase test. It then steers velocity from a clamped input, integrates motion from table-driven scaling, and writes a new table entry when a proximity test passes.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1F02
name: initialize_object_from_template
description: Initializes a new object record from a template: copies the template position, offsets height and speed by a global value, and sets flag bits and timers according to whether the template is in its special state. It also links the template reference; the routine references the text " taking off".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:1FFA
name: update_frame_timers_and_scale
description: Derives a time-step scale from a global clamped between 4 and 15, halved when a flag is set, and stores the scaled limits. It calls subsystem unnamed routines every frame and at periodic intervals, decrements a countdown and advances the frame counter, and when a second countdown reaches zero it sets a global to 5000 and a status byte to 255.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D4
name: decrement_two_counters_passthrough
description: Decrements two counter globals by one each call when they are nonzero and returns the low byte of the data register unchanged.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20D8
name: decrement_two_cooldown_counters
description: Decrements two counter globals by one each call when they are nonzero, and returns without a value.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:20F6
name: age_and_expire_effect_records
description: Advances two groups of short-lived records each frame: decrements their lifetimes, adds velocity to position, and clears a record when it moves beyond a distance from a reference or its lifetime ends. Cleared records trigger unnamed routine routines, and matching entries are checked against a second table; the routine references the text "destroyed by gunfire" and "Hit by gunfire".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:22C2
name: advance_spawned_particle_records
description: When the reference pointer is negative it returns a free slot index for a new record, clearing that slot on a frame-phase test. Otherwise it advances eight records by adding accelerating velocities to their position and speed, and on another frame-phase test writes a new record from the reference entry.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:234C
name: decay_and_add_velocity_term
description: When a positive counter is set, it reduces a secondary velocity term by twelve while that term is above minus sixteen, then adds the term to the counter.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2372
name: store_status_and_record_value
description: Sets a status global to 255 and stores the current value of a secondary global and an input register into a fixed slot of a record, then calls an unnamed routine.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:23A2
name: clamp_velocity_and_derive_offsets
description: Converts two velocity globals into position by shifting them right five bits, clamps each to a fixed range and resets the paired accumulator when clamped. It then derives two offsets from the input registers and calls unnamed routines that update the status globals.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:2466
name: save_state_and_raise_minimums
description: Saves four state globals into backup slots, then raises a counter field of every active record in a table to at least a value derived from a global level.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:24B6
name: find_nearest_matching_record
description: Scans 25 records for those whose flags match a pattern and picks the one with the smallest combined horizontal and vertical distance from a stored position, storing it as the current target. When the target changes it clears a flag bit on the previous and new records and stores both pointers.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:259C
name: run_optional_helper_pair
description: Clears a status global, calls an unnamed routine, and when the object's field at offset 12 is nonzero calls two unnamed routines and returns the second result, otherwise returning zero. The status global is cleared again before returning.

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:25A0
name: run_optional_helper_pair_text
description: Clears a status global, calls an unnamed routine, and when the object's field at offset 12 is nonzero calls two unnamed routines and returns the second result, otherwise returning zero. The routine references the text " at ".

key: f-15 strike eagle ii (1991)(microprose)(m3)[cr csl][h black rain](disk 1 of 2)/F-15 Strike Eagle II (1991)(MicroProse)(M3)[cr CSL][h Black Rain](Disk 1 of 2).adf:game:0:25E6
name: spawn_projectile_into_slot
description: When the reference record is not marked, selects a slot index from a frame bit and, if that slot is free, initializes it: sets its flag bits and handler, sets a fixed counter and speed, and adds a velocity offset whose sign follows a global. It then derives the record's position from its fixed-point values.
